ADDENDUM (Decree on Operational Commands) <No. 29321, December 4, 2018>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on January 1, 2019.

Article 2 Omitted.

Article 3 (Amendment of Other Statutes or Regulations) (1) through (10) Omitted.

(11) Part of the Decree on Divisions shall be amended as follows:

In Article 2, "Commander of the Field Army or the Commander of the Second Operations Command" shall be replaced with "Commander of the Ground Operations Command or the Commander of the Second Operations Command of the Army".

In the title of Article 6, "[text corrupted in the source, concerning military discipline]" shall be replaced with "(Maintenance of Military Discipline)", and in the main sentence of that Article, "military customs" shall be replaced with "military discipline".

(12) through (16) Omitted.

Article 4 Omitted.
